digest.component_or_area: Rebar structured-output orchestration vs. Pydantic AI seams
propositions: RP-01 proposes replacing Rebar's bespoke structured-output orchestration with Pydantic AI seams; the replacement is not behavior-preserving by default and encodes hard-won behaviors around deterministic repair, extraction, refusal/truncation, retry/tool/request limits, per-operation budgets, provider fallback, usage accounting, and failure taxonomy.

An offline integration probe must exercise Pydantic AI 1.107.2 native output, prompted output, output retry, usage limits, FallbackModel predicates, provider errors, truncation/refusal, telemetry, and artifact capture without live model calls, recording exact observables (call count, request mode, semantic output, exception class, usage fields, telemetry) for each predeclared scenario against Rebar test suite authority.

Seven material maintainer decisions were required to approve behavioral changes: one operation-wide request budget with raise-the-limit caveat; complete failed response on retry only when deterministically proven to fit, otherwise omit it whole; bounded output-size retry with concise guidance; terminal refusal/content-filter; aggregate successful-run usage across all attempts; re-raise only exact Rebar-owned output error from Pydantic cause chain; and trace-not-usage candidate observability.

The behavioral-contract matrix maps 38 deduplicated behavior-matrix rows to 15 historical ticket aliases plus ADR 0056, validated by 290 passing tests across 13 source suites; the offline probe exercised 28 observations against real Pydantic Agent, output, retry, UsageLimits, FallbackModel, Hooks, ProcessHistory, and FunctionModel seams with zero live provider calls.

All nine acceptance criteria are operator-attested: ticket/test scenario mapping, current Rebar behavior evidence, observed Pydantic 1.107.2 behavior, zero unauthorized intentional changes, real offline probe execution, research notes and probe script in .joe-janitor/, ticket comment with artifact paths and probe command/result, and operator-verified read-back matching local research note against live ticket JSON.

Implementation ticketization remains gated behind all seven Phase-4 maintainer decisions and is deferred to the pydantic-ai lane; research phase is complete as of 2026-08-16 with all decisions approved.
